# privacy-allowlist.txt - justified hits for .github/scripts/check-privacy.js.
#
# Format (one entry per line, fields separated by " | "):
#   rule | path-glob | line-regex (or - for any line) | one-line justification
# rule is notebook|email|userpath|key|term or * for all. Path globs are repo-relative;
# "*" stays inside a path segment, "**" crosses segments. Keep every entry as narrow
# as it can be: a path AND a line regex whenever the hit is a single known line.
# A new entry needs a real justification.

# Illustrative sample data in shipped code and docs; none of these is a real person.
userpath | cli/lib/hooks-merge.js | John Smith | code comment: example Windows path with a space in the user name
email | skills/browse/SKILL.md | user@test\.com | generic form-fill example
email | skills/feedback-pipeline/SKILL.md | x@y\.com | generic placeholder address
